messages:
deploy-bot: :warning: Release v2026.03.22 -> prod PAUSED by preflight: secret schema mismatch for key `DB_SECRET`. staging delivers structured JSON, prod has DSN string. See preflight: https://ci.internal/runs/9921

emma: Can someone drop the exact values from the check?

ci-bot: preflight diff:
```
staging: DB_SECRET={"host":"db.stg.internal","port":5432,"user":"svc_app","pass":"s3cr3t"}
prod: DB_SECRET=postgres://svc_app:s3cr3t@db.prod:5432/app?sslmode=require
```

raj: This is from the secret-schema migration for tenant-scoped services — we started storing structured creds to support rotation. Some older sidecars still expect a DSN string.

lucy: Sidecar parser will throw on `{` and abort connection setup. Canary run earlier showed 502s during startup when fed JSON.

ops-oncall: Change window closes in 1h30m. If we need an emergency production change we'll need infra lead sign-off.

emma: Options: 1) rollback to previous artifact (v2026.03.21) and backfill secret parity 2) add an init container to normalize JSON -> DSN at pod start 3) change runtime to accept both formats (bigger risk).

raj: Rollback is fastest but will reintroduce other pinned behavior differences. I can also add a DSN alias in paramstore (DB_SECRET_DSN) that points to a generated DSN for affected services.

lucy: If we add DB_SECRET_DSN we should update release notes and the runbook so ops knows to prefer the alias until we standardize schema.

sec-bot: Security check: adding an alias is fine provided we audit access and avoid logging raw creds. We need an access log entry for the backfill operation.

emma: I'll prepare a minimal init container that reads DB_SECRET (JSON) and sets DB_SECRET_DSN env. Can deploy as a hotpatch for canary only. Low blast radius.

raj: I'll create the DB_SECRET_DSN alias in prod paramstore now, leaving the original JSON untouched. ETA ~25m. Will emit audit entry.

ci-bot: note: integration tests that assert exact secret strings will need to read DB_SECRET_DSN once alias exists. Tests flagged earlier were the cause of preflight failure.

ops-oncall: Approve canary hotpatch if sec-bot verifies audit logs. @emma @raj coordinate and post canary URL.

emma: Spinning up a 10% canary with init-normalizer and env alias. Will run 15-min smoke and then widen.

raj: DB_SECRET_DSN alias created and audit logged. Leaving original key present.

emma: Canary smoke (15m) green: no parse failures, DB connections established. Metrics stable. :thumbsup:

ops-oncall: Infra review passed. Proceed limited rollout with monitoring window. Keep rollback plan ready.

lucy: Drafted release addendum: "Release paused for secret schema drift; temporary compatibility alias DB_SECRET_DSN created; follow-up work: standardize secret schema across environments and remove alias." Confluence: https://confluence/internal/releases/v2026.03.22-secret-schema-note

deploy-bot: Release v2026.03.22 status: PAUSED -> CANARY (normalizer init) -> LIMITED_ROLLOUT pending. Assigned: raj (alias/backfill), emma (canary/hotpatch), lucy (release notes). Action items logged.

ci-bot: final: preflight run id=9921 recorded, failing checks resolved after alias + init-normalizer. Tests updated to accept DB_SECRET_DSN.

lucy: Will update the runbook with steps to revert alias and remove init after full rollout.

deploy-bot: Note recorded: reason=env-parity-secret-schema-drift; decision=use init-normalizer + alias for controlled rollout; follow-up ticket created for secret standardization.
